sql:
SELECT 
    (y2012.Consumption - y2013.Consumption) / y2012.Consumption AS consumption_decrease_rate
FROM 
    yearmonth y2012
JOIN 
    yearmonth y2013 ON y2012.CustomerID = y2013.CustomerID
JOIN 
    transactions_1k t ON y2012.CustomerID = t.CustomerID
WHERE 
    y2012.Date = '2012-08-25'
AND 
    t.Price * t.Amount = 634.8
AND 
    y2013.Date = '2013-08-25'
